name: podcast_network
archetype: Independent podcast network for technology and culture
market: Podcast listeners, tech and culture audience, 25-45, subscription audio
density: Medium. Show artwork is the visual hero — large square podcast cover art in a grid. Episode descriptions brief. Audio player embed at top. Subscribe links for all podcast platforms. Clean and audio-first.
nav_style: Minimal nav with network name logo. Shows, Episodes, Newsletter, Support Us. Right: mini audio player widget always visible showing currently playing (or latest) episode. Patreon or membership CTA button.
commercial_model: Listener-supported. Premium subscription removes ads, gives bonus episodes and early access. Patreon integration. Ad spots within shows (described but not played). Occasional sponsor acknowledgments. Network-branded merchandise.
color_palette: Deep purple (#3C1F6B) as primary — audio, night, intellectual. Cream (#F5F0E8) for readable backgrounds. Coral accent (#FF6B6B) for CTAs and new episode badges. Episode artwork colors bleed through with CSS filters creating warm ambient color variation. Dark mode as default.
typography: Freight Display for show names — editorial, authoritative. Karla or Source Sans Pro for episode titles and descriptions. Mono font for episode numbers. Time stamps in small tabular figures. Transcript text in clean serif for readability.

pages.title: Home
pages.description: Network hero with tagline. Show grid with large cover art. Latest episode player widget. Featured episode highlight. Newsletter signup. Support the network donation section. About the network blurb.

pages.title: All Shows
pages.description: Show directory grid. Each show card: cover art, show title, one-line description, episode count, subscribe links for Apple Podcasts / Spotify / RSS. Genre/category filter.

pages.title: Latest Episodes
pages.description: Episode feed across all shows. Episode cards: show artwork thumbnail, episode title, show name, date, duration, play button. Filter by show. Search by keyword. Pagination.

pages.title: Episode Page
pages.description: Full episode page: embedded audio player, episode title, show name, date, description, show notes with time-stamped chapters, guests bio, links mentioned, transcript link, share buttons.

pages.title: Support the Network
pages.description: Listener support page. What your support does section. Membership tiers: Free, Plus ($7/mo), Supporter ($15/mo) with benefits comparison. Patreon embed. One-time donation option. Merchandise shop preview.
